execution_contract.input: Task_ID + Object_IDs + native source rev/hash + family/domain + intent + scopes + device/current capabilities + lease + evidence ceiling + data budget
path: Resolve exact source roots and permissions
Select one primary task lens and on-demand secondary panels
Plan via deterministic algorithms and optional AI suggestions
Challenge with independent numerical/physical proof as applicable
Run on registered leased capability or HOLD
Read back result, digest and source receipt
Write to source owner, reconcile DBR State Root, propagate minimal verified delta
execution_contract.physical_command_rule: Requires real C0 deterministic controller, hardware identity, calibration, local safe-state, verified operator/release lease; an AI can plan but cannot authorise safety bypass or actuation.
execution_contract.provider_change_rule: Never overwrite native provider files without exact owner current head/revision and rollback; existing documents and Windows user Documents excluded.

founder_universal_filespace_identity_202.semantic_equivalence: CGX == FileSpace; two labels for one universal product, NOT two data stores/services/master identity spaces

aliases.role: older product route; preserve as historical/compatibility alias pending owner policy

founder_universal_filespace_identity_202.identity_invariant: Resolver MUST bind aliases to the existing signed namespace/Object_ID/State Root/DBR Root; letter casing, pathname, extension and address alone confer neither identity nor trust
founder_universal_filespace_identity_202.canonical_carrier_scope: one semantic root/Filespace can have sparse projections/multiple storage providers/ZIP-compatible Phase A carrier; logical unified filesystem does NOT mean one physical database/server/blob
founder_universal_filespace_identity_202.data_space: DataSpace is the federated exchange/collaboration/state-routing CAPABILITY of interoperating CGX FileSpaces; not a second version of the universal filespace
founder_universal_filespace_identity_202.print_space: PrintSpace is a separately qualified digital-to-empirical execution edge consuming FileSpace+DataSpace models and returning measured, method-bound DBR evidence
founder_universal_filespace_identity_202.planned_interoperability: human/machine inspect/read/write through source-owned projections; native PDFs/DOCX/XLSX/SQL/CAD/GLB/3MF, agents, apps and APIs remain native preserved inputs and governed capabilities, not mandatory full conversion or blanket credential access

workflow: Authenticated distinct device/node enrollment and scoped capability/permission/lease negotiation
Read native Drive/Git/local file within source ACL and produce object envelope referencing signed type/instance/provider revision and hashes
Select minimum permissible data slice for semantic state and task-specific hydration
Content-addressed node exchange with interrupted/resumed transfer, idempotent recipient write, digest-size readback
Delegated computation to admissible local no-model/classical/AI capability only with explicit lease and input snapshot hash
Return typed result/unknown/uncertainty with exact inputs/capability/version and receipt
Overlay proposed semantic delta without changing owner state; support disagreement and dual acceptance across child families
Owner approval gated Resolve, atomic State Root and DBR Root with ancestor closures and recoverable history
Independent offline/read-only degraded operation and cross-node resync with conflict preservation; never newest-timestamp-wins
Optional physical device/PrintSpace step requires independent C0 interlocks, qualified process and measured return receipt
